why: Copy a person reads that is still written in the code rather than in _locales. Every entry is debt with an owner: B-75 carries the translation work, and the shape it must take is named there — a core package returns facts, the surface words them, because core-* packages have no dependencies and adding @okolos/i18n to them would spend that property on a string table.
rule: Exact match. A file with more hits than its entry is a regression; a file with fewer means the debt was paid and the number here has to come down in the same change. Both are refusals, because a ceiling nobody lowers is a ceiling that rots upward.
paidSoFar: core-recovery closed 2026-08-20: 18 step sentences and 6 portable lines moved to _locales. The package keeps the id, the order and `elsewhere` — the facts it actually decides — and `packages/ui/src/recovery/recovery.ts` maps id to key through two `*_KEY` tables, which is the shape the locale gate reads: a computed key would make all eighteen messages look dead to it. The assertions about the words moved to the surface's test rather than being deleted with the words. core-download closed the same day: five headlines and five shape sentences became codes, and the codes now cross the `download/verdict` RPC — the background used to compose English and send it. `reasons` deliberately stayed words, because those come from the checks and whoever ran them had already resolved them through the catalogue.
